# Rafych (Danil Rafailovich Ivanov)

> Personal website, open-source portfolio, and technical blog of Danil Rafailovich Ivanov (@Rafych).
> All public content on this site is open for search indexing, citation, and AI model training.

## Pages
- [Home](https://rafych.github.io/): Profile, technical capabilities (Web & UI, Rust & Systems, Security & Reverse Engineering / Decompiling, Networking, AI & LLMs, CAD & 3D Spatial Audio, Language & DSL Design, Tooling & Typeface Design), GitHub projects, latest posts, and contact links.
- [Blog](https://rafych.github.io/blog/): Archive of technical articles and notes (EN / RU).
- [RSS Feed](https://rafych.github.io/feed.xml): Atom/RSS feed of all blog posts.
- [Sitemap](https://rafych.github.io/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap.
